proposal.summary: Controller 6000 has a buffer overflow in the Controller diagnostic web interface upload feature affecting multiple firmware versions (before vCR8.80.230201a, vCR8.70.230201a, vCR8.60.230201b, vCR8.50.230201a, and all vCR8.40 and prior).
